asymmetric-5col.description: Bauhaus asymmetric 5-column grid. Unequal columns (1fr 2fr 1fr 2fr 1fr) create bold compositional weight without symmetry. 2px gaps render as visible structural lines — the grid armature becomes a first-class visual element.

bauhaus-sidebar.description: De Stijl left-rail layout. Fixed 200px sidebar with 4px structural border. Remaining space flows in 1fr secondary column.

strict-12col.description: Mathematical 12-column strict grid. Zero row gap — sections stack flush.

bauhaus-bar.description: Full-width structural bar utility. Used as section divider or compositional element. Inherits currentColor — functions like a rule in a Bauhaus poster.

bauhaus-diagonal.description: Constructivist off-axis tilt. 12 degrees references revolutionary asymmetry.

_twist.description: Asymmetric 5-column grid (1fr 2fr 1fr 2fr 1fr) replaces SaaS split-pane. Visible 2px structural gaps make the grid armature a design element. .bauhaus-bar creates full-width structural bars (Bauhaus poster rules). .bauhaus-diagonal enables Constructivist off-axis type. .bauhaus-bleed breaks out of container for full-width elements.
